title: Homilies on Jeremiah, Homilies 1–2
blurb: Origen on Jeremiah. Twenty Greek homilies survive; this page has Homilies 1–2 (Jeremiah 1:2–10 and 2:21–22). The rest of the volume is still being translated.
first_english_note: These Greek homilies had no earlier complete English a reader could freely use. This page is Homilies 1–2 only. The English here is new.

text_history.method: English follows Erich Klostermann, Origenes Werke III (GCS, 1901). A second transcription of that same edition (First1KGreek TEI) was checked; where the TEI drops or garbles a line, the page image wins. This is a reading translation for study, not a new critical edition of the Greek. Homilies that survive only in Jerome’s Latin are not on this page yet. When they are, they will be marked at those homilies.
